$comment: Pilot partner record — copy to pilot/partners/<label>.json (gitignored). Manual, file-based; this file IS the partner registry, read by humans only. NO secrets in this file, ever: the tokens live in the Worker's TENANTS secret and are only referenced here.
label: acme
$status_values: active (tenant entry live in TENANTS) | disabled (entry kept, "disabled": true — every authenticated route returns 500 internal_error (/health stays 200), which the partner cannot distinguish from a config defect) | revoked (entry deleted from TENANTS)
tokenRef: wrangler secret TENANTS, entry "acme" — admin_token + verifier_token
$trustedOperators_note: The partner's BabyJubjub operator public key(s), as x:y decimal pairs. Add the key to the tenant's trusted_operators in TENANTS — that list is the trust anchor the Worker applies to this tenant's requests; this file is the per-partner record of which keys are theirs.

tierCaps.$note: @bolyra/mpp financial tiers over the SDK's cumulative permission bits: small < $100, medium < $10,000 (implies small), unlimited (implies both). Enforced by the credential's permission bitmask + the capability map — this field is the agreed pilot cap, recorded for the humans.
